rationale: Appending the patently false limit claim `lim_{r→∞} ν(r)/r` as an alleged equivalent of the logarithmic slope definition inside the displayed equation — for any physical stellar system ν(r)→0 faster than 1/r at large r, so the limit equals 0 not −dlog ν/dlog r, which Wolfram Limit[] immediately refutes.
